summary: CWE-572: The bad() method invoked Thread.run() directly, which executes the run() body synchronously on the calling thread instead of spawning a new thread. Replaced the run() call with start() so the Runnable actually executes on a separate thread, preserving the feature (the thread still runs its body and writes its line). Added a join() so the thread completes before bad() returns, keeping output deterministic.
